title: "What is a field?"

::: {.oneline}
A field assigns a dynamical variable to every point in space; its normal modes are independent oscillators, and quantising those modes is what produces particles.
:::

## Short answer

*To write.* A field assigns a dynamical variable to every point in space; its normal modes are independent oscillators, and quantising those modes is what produces particles.
